page.overview:
Who is Philippa Eilhart?

Philippa Eilhart (Polish: Filippa Eilhart) was a sorceress and King Vizimir II's advisor, who remained a powerful figure at Redania's court even after his death, for which she was likely responsible. She was one of the few mages with the rare ability to polymorph, and was able to turn at will into a large grey owl.

She led the Thanedd coup against the Brotherhood of Sorcerers, intending to neutralize suspected traitors allied with Nilfgaard. Later, she initiated the founding of the Lodge of Sorceresses and was considered its leader. The all female organization secretly met at Montecalvo, Philippa's home base.

She was one of the victims of the Witch Hunts in the s, having been tortured and killed by Archpriest Willemer's men. Many years later, she was exonerated and canonized as Martyr Saint.

Philippa studied magic under the auspices of Tissaia de Vries, probably at Aretuza, the magical school for sorceresses on Thanedd Island. She would later claim the position of a royal advisor at the court of Vizimir II, King of Redania, as well as a seat on the Council of Wizards, one of the two ruling bodies of the Brotherhood of Sorcerers, which governed and guided magical use and practice in the Northern Kingdoms.

Also known as: Philippa, Phil.
